cd /workspace/tools && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('fuzz.py'); t=p.read_text()
start=t.index("    def captures(self):")
end=t.index("def reference_pipeline(job):")
new = '''    def captures(self):
        rng = self.rng
        rows = list(self.rows)
        rng.shuffle(rows)
        groups = [[] for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 4))]
        for index, values in enumerate(rows):
            groups[index % len(groups)].append(values)
        captures = []
        for values in groups:
            lines = [HEADER]
            for row in values:
                cells = []
                for cell in row:
                    text = str(cell)
                    if rng.random() < .04 and text and ',' not in text and '"' not in text:
                        text = '"%s"' % text
                    cells.append(text)
                lines.append(','.join(cells))
            blob = ('\\r\\n'.join(lines) + '\\r\\n').encode()
            if rng.random() < .5:
                data = zstd_compress(rng, blob)
                encoding = 'zstd'
            else:
                data, encoding = blob, 'csv'
            captures.append({'encoding': encoding, 'chunks': split_chunks(rng, data)})
        if rng.random() < .12:
            captures.append({'encoding': rng.choice(['csv', 'zstd']), 'chunks': []})
            self.expect_capture_error = True
        return captures


'''
t = t[:start] + new + t[end:]
t = t.replace("""import base64, hashlib, ipaddress, json, plistlib, random, struct, sys, io, csv as csvmod""",
"""import base64, hashlib, ipaddress, json, plistlib, random, struct, sys, io, csv as csvmod
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd


def zstd_compress(rng, blob):
    data = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=rng.choice([1, 3, 12]),
                               write_checksum=rng.random() < .5).compress(blob)
    if rng.random() < .25:
        data = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=1).compress(b'') + data
    return data


def split_chunks(rng, data, count=None):
    if not data:
        return []
    count = count if count is not None else rng.randrange(1, 5)
    cuts = sorted(rng.sample(range(1, len(data)), min(count - 1, len(data) - 1))) \\
        if len(data) > 1 and count > 1 else []
    out = []
    previous = 0
    for cut in cuts + [len(data)]:
        out.append(base64.b64encode(data[previous:cut]).decode())
        previous = cut
    if rng.random() < .2:
        out.insert(rng.randrange(len(out) + 1), '')
    return out""")
p.write_text(t)
